comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego initiates by turning onto the trafficway occupied by responder agent1. Chosen assumptions: ego turns left into the inner lane of a multilane receiving road. Agent1 approaches straight in that same inner lane, then evades into the same-direction lane on its right after ego enters its path and the target lane is clear. Right-adjacent lanes are required on the initial approaches and receiving road; the actual evasion is gated until agent1 reaches the receiving road. Speeds, initial distances, a nominal entry-time gap, and any response delay are chosen assumptions; no collision outcome is required.
